column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “as” in “Flee as a bird to your mountain” and continues the quotation through verse 3.
Close to the Hebrew; “what does he do” is rendered “What can the righteous do?”
Close to the Hebrew; the second “Yahweh” is rendered “the Lord's” rather than “the LORD.”
NASB joins “and the wicked” to “tests the righteous,” where the Hebrew accents join it to “and the one who loves violence.”
“Their face(s) will see” is rendered “The upright will behold His face”; the Hebrew can also mean that His face beholds the upright.
